content_of_post_to_comment: Someone else said this recently and I’ve been thinking about it: I’d much rather read an article than watch a video. Maybe it’s the lack of sound or the ability to take my own time with the information. Either way, platforms outside of this one would have me believe I’m in the minority.
comment: Video optimizes for attention; writing leaves more room for thought. Maybe the real divide isn't the medium, but whether we want information delivered to us or something we can wrestle with at our own pace.
